<title>Obsidian Signal — NÖRDS background</title>
<desc id="desc">Professional pitch-black vector backdrop with a spectral cyan, violet, magenta and amber geometric signal on the right. The left area is deliberately clear for legible page copy.</desc>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="base" x1="0" y1="0" x2="100%" y2="100%"><stop stop-color="#010308"/><stop offset=".52" stop-color="#010207"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#070207"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="spectral" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="60%"><stop stop-color="#2baeff"/><stop offset=".2" stop-color="#4c52fa"/><stop offset=".46" stop-color="#b43bfc"/><stop offset=".66" stop-color="#ef448e"/><stop offset=".83" stop-color="#ff7f30"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffce76"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="coolWarm" x1="0%" y1="50%" x2="100%" y2="50%"><stop stop-color="#258ffd"/><stop offset=".26" stop-color="#9c46f6"/><stop offset=".56" stop-color="#fb388f"/><stop offset=".8" stop-color="#fa7b34"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffd38a"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="signalN" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="100%" y2="0%"><stop stop-color="#408cff"/><stop offset=".35" stop-color="#c253fb"/><stop offset=".66" stop-color="#ff4c89"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffa044"/></linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="halo" cx="68%" cy="49%" r="50%"><stop stop-color="#3c0a39" stop-opacity=".38"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#190b35" stop-opacity=".18"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="ember" cx="80%" cy="58%" r="65%"><stop stop-color="#853010" stop-opacity=".18"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
  <linearGradient id="leftMask" x1="0%" y1="0" x2="100%" y2="0"><stop stop-color="#010308" stop-opacity=".97"/><stop offset=".40" stop-color="#010308" stop-opacity=".94"/><stop offset=".60" stop-color="#010308" stop-opacity=".75"/><stop offset=".78" stop-color="#010308" stop-opacity=".12"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#010308" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="fadeV" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%"><stop stop-color="#020207" stop-opacity=".28"/><stop offset=".25" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset=".83" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#030207" stop-opacity=".65"/></linearGradient>
  <filter id="glow" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="260%" height="260%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/></filter>
  <filter id="bloom" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="15"/></filter>
  <filter id="soft" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="32"/></filter>
  <clipPath id="canvas"><rect width="1600" height="450"/></clipPath>
</defs>
